spans.s:
m. (-टः)
A plant: see लाङ्गली, (Commelina salicifolia.)
n. (-टं)
Another species of the same, (Commelina Bengalensis.)
E.
कं water, and चट to divide; alluding to the habits of the plant.

m. (-डः)
A plant, (Commelina Bengalensis): see the preceding.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
कं heaven, and चर to go, affix अण्.

f. (-का)
1 The branch of a bamboo.
2 A small boil.

n. (-कं)
Sour gruel: see काञ्जिक.

m. (-कः)
1 The skin of a snake.
2 Armour, mail.
3 A bodice or jacket.
4 Cloth, clothes.
5 A kind of drawers or short breeches.
f. (-की)
The name of a plant.
E.
कचि to bind or shine, affix उकन्.

m. (-लुः)
A snake.
E.
कञ्चुक a serpent's skin, and आलुक poss. aff.

m. (-की)
1 An attendant on the women's apartments.
2 A libidinous man, a debauchee.
3 A serpent.
4

Agallochum.
5

Barley.
6

A sort of pulse, (Chenna.)
E.
कञ्चुक armour, &c. इनि aff.

f. (-का)
A bodice or jacket.

mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं)
Produced in or from water.
m. (-ञ्जः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

The hair.
n. (-ञ्जं)
1 Nectar, the food of the immortals.
2 A lotus.
E.
कं happiness, water, &c. and ज what is born or produced.

m. (-कः)
A kind of bird, the Mayana: see कञ्जन.

m. (-जः)
A name of BRAHMĀ.
E.
कञ्ज a lotus, and ज born.

m. (-नः)
1 The Mayana or Maina, (Gracula religiosa.)
2 A name of KANDARPA, the deity of love.
E.
कचि to go, युच् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

The sun.
3 The belly.
4 An elephant.
E.
कञ्ज a lotus, &c. ऋ to hate or injure, अच or घञ् affix कञ्जार, the pen. made short; also derived by some from कजि, a Sautra root, to produce or grow, and अर Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Muni or holy sage.
2 BRAHMĀ, &c. see कञ्जर.

m. (-लः)
The Maina: see कञ्जन.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica): see ब्रह्मयष्टिका.

nf. (-कः-का)
Sour gruel, the water of boiled rice in a state of spontaneous fermentation.
E.
क water, अञ्ज to go, &c. and affix इक; also the vowel being lengthened काञ्जीक, or without the final, काञ्जी.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Golden, of gold.
n. (-नं)
1

Gold.
2

Wealth.
3

A filament of the lotus.
m. (-नः)
1 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.)
2 A tree bearing a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.)
3 Another plant, (Mesua ferrea): see नागकेसर.
4 Glomerous fig tree: see उदुम्बर.
5 Common thorn apple, (Datura metel.)
f. (-नी)
1

Turmeric.
2

A yellow pigment.
E.
कचि to shine, &c. ल्युट् affix, the radical vowel lengthened; this etymology gives the meaning gold, the others refer to their colour, &c. in which they resemble the metal.

m. (-कः)
Mountain ebony, &c.
n. (-कं)
Yellow orpiment.
E.
काञ्चन gold, &c. and कन् affix, implying resemblance or identity.

m. (-रः)
A gold mine.
E.
काञ्चन, and कन्दर a cave.

f. (-णी)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus): see शतमूली.

m. (-रिः)
Mount Sumeru.
E.
काच्चन, and गिरि a mountain; the golden mountain.

m. (-यः)
A heap of gold.
E.
काञ्चन, and चय assemblage.

f. (-भूः)
1 Gold dust.
2 A golden or yellow soil.
E.
काञ्चन, and भू soil.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Golden.
E.
काञ्चन, and मयट् aff.

m. (-प्रः)
A hill or mound of gold.
E.
काञ्चन, and वप्र a mound.

f. (-न्धिः)
A treaty of friendship between two parties on equal terms.
E.
काञ्चन, and सन्धि alliance.

m. (-लः)
Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.)
E.
काञ्चन gold, and अल to be able or like; some copies read काञ्चनार.

f. (-या)
A yellow pigment, commonly Gorocanā.
E.
काचि to shine, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-ञ्चिः)
See काञ्ची.

f. (-ञ्ची)
1 A woman's zone or girdle.
2 The name of an ancient city situated in the peninsula, and one of the seven sacred cities of the

Hindus.
3

A plant, (Abrus precatorious): see गुञ्चा.
E.
काचि to bind or shine, इन or ङीष् affixes; whence also काञ्चि.

n. (-दं)
Mons veneris, the pubic region.
E.
काञ्ची the zone, and पद place, site.
